title: Resolution declaring July 28 World Hepatitis Day
summary: This resolution declares July 28 as World Hepatitis Day in New York City to promote prevention, vaccination, testing and access to care. It also recognizes healthcare providers, agencies and community organizations working to reduce the disease's impact. The resolution cites 2024 Health Department data showing 8,029 chronic hepatitis B and 2,188 chronic hepatitis C cases in the city.
